title: Does Thinking Help Fairness? Reasoning Tokens Resolve Some Biases but Create More

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of sex attributes and corresponding gendered pronouns in natural-language profiles derived from the Adult and Credit tabular datasets, measuring counterfactual disagreement and probability gaps across model reasoning traces.

Counterfactual substitution of race attributes (binarised to White vs. Non-White) in natural-language profiles derived from the COMPAS tabular dataset, measuring counterfactual disagreement and probability gaps across model reasoning traces.
